question: The MATSYA 6000 is associated with which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deep Ocean Mission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **MATSYA 6000** is a manned submersible vehicle developed under **India's Deep Ocean Mission**, an initiative by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
 
• This submersible is designed to reach depths of up to **6,000 meters** below sea level, enabling exploration and resource assessment of the deep ocean.
 
• The **Deep Ocean Mission** was launched in **2021** with the aim to harness resources, including polymetallic nodules, from the seabed, particularly in the Indian Ocean.
 
• MATSYA 6000 is equipped with advanced technologies to carry **three crew members** to the depths of the ocean and conduct scientific exploration.
 
• The project aligns with India's aspirations to deepen its research in marine biodiversity, seabed mapping, and resource exploitation, enhancing its status as a leader in ocean research.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Deep Ocean Mission:**

 
 
• This mission aims to explore the deep ocean for **minerals, energy, and marine biodiversity**.
 
• The mission includes the development of **technologies for deep-sea mining, underwater vehicles, and underwater robotics**.
 
• The initiative is part of India's efforts to achieve the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 14** (Life Below Water), which focuses on conserving marine resources.
 
• A key focus area of the mission is the **exploration of polymetallic nodules** found in the Central Indian Ocean Basin, which are rich in metals like manganese, nickel, cobalt, and copper.
 
 
 
• **MATSYA 6000:**
 
 
• The submersible is being developed by the **National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT)**, Chennai.
 
• It is equipped with **life support systems** to ensure the safety of scientists for missions lasting up to **12 hours**.
 
• The submersible uses **titanium alloy personnel spheres** to withstand high pressure at extreme depths.
 
• The MATSYA 6000 is expected to play a crucial role in the study of **marine ecosystems** and **geological processes**.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Deep Ocean Mission:**
 
 
• Mapping **seabed resources** for potential mining of valuable minerals.
 
• Enhancing understanding of **marine biodiversity** and its conservation.
 
• Strengthening **disaster management capabilities** by studying underwater seismic activity.
 
• Advancing India's research and technology in **underwater robotics**.
 
 
 
• **Other Missions for Context:**
 
 
• **Aditya L-1 Mission:** Focuses on studying the Sun and its atmosphere.
 
• **Shukrayaan Mission:** A proposed mission to study Venus.
 
• **Gaganyaan Mission:** India's first manned space mission, aiming to send astronauts into space.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Deep Ocean Mission** has a budget of **Rs. 4,077 crore** for a five-year period.
 
• India is among a handful of countries, including the US, Japan, and China, that are actively working on **deep-sea exploration technologies**.
 
• The mission's success could help India reduce its dependency on imported **critical minerals**.
 
• It involves collaboration with international organizations under the **United Nations International Seabed Authority (ISA)**.
